versions.content: Definition of configuration classes for all CDD configuration parameters and references For the CDD module the standardized configuration pa- rameters do not specify any configuration class. It is up to the implementor of the specific CDD module to define the configuration class for all configuration parameters - standardized and vendor specific ones in the VSMD.
